يسلون (form I)
# يَسُلُّونَ (yasullūna) /ja.sul.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of سَلَّ (salla)
# يُسَلُّونَ (yusallūna) /ju.sal.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of سَلَّ (salla) and سُلَّ (sulla)
